library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: In the generated build.gradle for org.hibernate:hibernate-spatial:8.0.0.Beta1, change the main test dependency from `testImplementation "org.hibernate:hibernate-spatial:$libraryVersion"` to `testImplementation "org.hibernate.orm:hibernate-spatial:$libraryVersion"`. Verified locally: the org.hibernate group id is a Maven POM relocation stub (packaging=pom, distributionManagement/relocation) for hibernate-orm 7.0.0.Final and later, including 8.0.0.Beta1; resolving it directly conflicts with the hibernate-platform BOM's endorsed strict version constraints, while depending on org.hibernate.orm:hibernate-spatial directly resolves cleanly (hibernate-core, geolatte-geom, jts-core, slf4j-api all pulled in without conflict). No other source changes are needed — the existing test (HibernateSpatialTest.java, using org.hibernate.boot.registry.StandardServiceRegistryBuilder and org.hibernate.spatial.integration.SpatialInitializer) compiles unchanged against 8.0.0.Beta1; both classes are still present in the 8.0.0.Beta1 jars under the same package names. No Docker image or system property is needed — the test only builds a StandardServiceRegistryBuilder, no live database.
risks: This same org.hibernate → org.hibernate.orm relocation affects every hibernate-spatial version from 7.0.0.Final onward, not just 8.0.0.Beta1, so any future version bump for this library will need the same coordinate fix.
